caution_findings.evidence_context: Linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows sometimes label unstarred source MIC rows as IC50; final database audit preserves these as source_conflict records rather than normalizing them.
Table 3 asterisks denote 50% inhibition; those values are retained as partial_inhibition_concentration and not promoted to complete MIC.
The ten local supplementary .bin assets are article landing HTML copies, not structured supplement tables; XML/OA/PDF and merged database rows provided the gate-changing evidence.
